title: Joe Burrow opens up about injuries, Trey Hendrickson, 2026 expectations

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Joe Burrow opens up about injuries, Trey Hendrickson, 2026 expectations
sources.description: Cincinnati Bengals QB Joe Burrow said his body is feeling the best it has in a long time after a foot injury cost him half of the 2025 NFL season.
